cli.usage:
Fav Session Manager — all your Claude Code / Codex sessions: favorite, search, resume in one keystroke

  fav                       default UI (FAV_UI=fzf|tui)
  fav tui | fav fzf         pick a front end
  fav add                   read the JSON produced by the /fav skill from stdin
  fav list [query]          list favorites (--json / --line)
  fav sessions [query]      list every session on this machine, favorited or not (--json)
  fav show <id>             one record (--json)
  fav preview <id>          render the preview block
  fav status <id> todo|doing|done
  fav done <id>             = status done
  fav archive|unarchive <id>
  fav fav|unfav <id>        favorite / unfavorite (record kept)
  fav pin|unpin <id>        keep the transcript with a hard link
  fav edit <id>             edit title / tags / summary in $EDITOR
  fav rm <id|session id>    move a session's files to the trash (-y skips the prompt) (alias: delete)
  fav trash                 list the trash (--json; --restore <id|session id>; --purge drops expired, --purge --all empties it after a prompt, -y skips)
  fav mv <old dir> <new dir>  move a project: rewrite cwd in its sessions (-y skips the prompt) (alias: move)
  fav fix [dir] [query] [n…]   sessions whose directory moved: list (default), move with numbers / session ids / all (--to picks the target)
  fav clean [dir] [query] [n…] unrecoverable sessions: list (default), trash with numbers / session ids / all
  fav resume <id>           resume (--dry-run / --no-herdr)
  fav doctor                health check (--compact compacts the data file)
  fav version               print the version
  fav install-skill         install the /fav skill into Claude and Codex
  fav uninstall-skill       remove the /fav skill (only the symlinks)
  fav shell-init [zsh|bash] [--key ctrl-g] [--ui fzf|tui]  print shell code binding a key to fav fzf: put eval "$(fav shell-init zsh)" in .zshrc

Query: #tag project:x provider:claude status:open|active|done|archived|trash|all|live
       after:2026-09-01 before:… last:7d turns:3 plus plain keywords (AND)

help.chat_move: move the right-pane highlight older / newer; near the end it loads another page (20 msgs). j/k work too when the right pane has focus
help.chip_row: enter / leave the filter chip row (← → move, Enter open)
help.close_tab: close its Herdr tab (asks first; the agent inside ends too)
help.delete: delete the session: its files move to the trash (~/.agent/fav/trash), purged after the configured days; in the trash filter D restores it. Running sessions cannot be deleted
help.done_archive: x mark done (again: back to doing); a archive / unarchive without touching status; works on any session, no need to favorite first
help.edit: edit title / tags / summary in place (Tab next field, Enter or Ctrl+S save, Enter is newline in summary); in the resume box e edits the title only
help.enter: narrow: open details; wide: open the resume box. Running sessions get the same box, with the primary button becoming "switch" (Herdr) or "attach" (claude --bg)
help.enter_chat: open this message in full with every step after it; j/k line, Space/b page, ctrl+d/u half page; ← → previous / next message; y copy
help.enter_group: fold / unfold the group under the cursor in the projects view (→ unfold, ← fold; all folded by default, the cursor can rest on a header, the right pane then shows the project summary)
help.esc: close overlay; back to list; clear filters
help.favorite: favorite / unfavorite depending on state; unfavoriting keeps the record, press again to restore
help.filters: tag / project / source (cycles) / time filter; the time box accepts 09-01, 09-01..09-15, ..09-15, 7d
help.find: find in this session's messages (/ does the same when the right pane has focus); next / previous hit
help.fold_all: fold / unfold all groups in the projects view (- fold, = or + unfold)
help.ide: open the session directory in the IDE (Rebased by default, configurable) / VS Code
help.move: move up / down; ctrl+n/p also work inside the search box
help.move_project: move the project directory: on a group header the whole project (subdirectories follow), on a session just that one. Pick the new directory in the browser; cwd inside every transcript is rewritten, the Claude project folder and ~/.claude.json entry follow, originals go to the trash. Refused while any of its sessions is running. CLI: fav mv <old> <new>, fav fix finds where a missing directory went
help.note_agents: The Agents page polls every 3 s and marks cards waiting (red) / working / idle for / finished, sorted by session start so positions stay put; with the cursor on one, the right pane refreshes along, but not while the right pane has focus or is scrolled to older messages; the title then shows "new +N". FAV_TRACE=1 fav logs wheel, key and background events to ~/.agent/fav/trace.log.
help.note_drag: Drag across any text on screen (titles, paths, messages, full text) and release to copy; for the terminal's own selection hold Shift (Option in iTerm2) while dragging, or disable the mouse with --no-mouse.
help.note_ime: With a CJK input method on, lowercase letters get eaten by the composer: * favorites, the rest have ctrl combos (ctrl+x done, ctrl+a archive, ctrl+e edit, ctrl+y copy, ctrl+n/p move, ctrl+g resume), plus arrows / Enter / Tab / Esc / paging keys; uppercase keys (D M X G J K N) pass through the IME; filters go through ; into the chip row; every action is also a button in the Enter dialog.
help.note_mouse: Mouse: click a tab to switch view, a chip to filter, a card to select, double-click to resume, wheel to scroll.
help.page: page / half page / top and bottom; same in the chat pane
help.pane: switch pane focus; move between chips in the filter row; move between buttons in an overlay
help.quit: quit (ctrl+c also works in the search box and overlays)
help.search: search: records when the list has focus, this session's messages when the right pane has (like less / vim)
help.settings: settings: time display, default tab / sort, short-session threshold, wheel, icons, mouse, trash retention, IDE, language
help.sort: sort: last active → session time → favorited time → turns; on Agents it cycles by start time → grouped by status → by last activity
help.space: press the primary button without the box: switch / attach if running, else resume; on a project group header it folds / unfolds
help.status: status filter: unarchived / active / done / archived / all / trash
help.t_resume: resume in this terminal instead of Herdr
